title: Paeonol alleviates PD-1 deficiency-induced anxiety-like behaviors through reversing the neurotransmitter metabolic disorders in spleen-brain axis.
authors: You, Luyan; Liu, Tongzheng; Yu, Zhenjiang; Wang, Xinyu; Zhang, Jichun; Wang, Xuenan; Li, Zifa; Zhang, Hao; Hu, Minghui; Zai, Xiang; Zhang, Qun; Chen, Kai; Wei, Sheng; Lv, Cui; Geng, Xiwen
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芍药苷缓解PD-1缺陷小鼠焦虑样行为，涉及免疫代谢与分子对接，但核心为免疫-神经行为机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Anxiety are frequently observed in patients with programmed cell death-1 (PD-1) blockade therapy, which is related with the overactivation of the immune system. Paeonol was described to regulate immune function and relieve mood symptoms, but no study focused on its mechanism on the emotional disorders caused by PD-L1/PD-1 blockade therapy. PURPOSE: With Pdcd1(-/-) mice, we aim to evaluate the paeonol's anxiolytic effect and focus on the mechanism about the neurotransmitter metabolic shifts caused by T cells overactivation in peripheral immune organs. METHODS: On the basis of the behavioral tests, we firstly quantified the contents of key neurotransmitters and their precursors in two brain regions and in spleen and lymph nodes of Pdcd1(-/-)mice. Then, we used flow cytometry with Treg suppression assay to explore paeonol's effects on CD4(+)T-cell function. Finally, molecular-docking were performed between paeonol and the forkhead box protein 3 (Foxp3) to predict the putative targets. RESULTS: In Pdcd1(-/-) mice, the inhibitory effect of Tregs on CD4(+)T cells was diminished, resulting in the upregulation of CD44(high) in spleen. This hyperactivity of CD4(+)T cells caused the spleen to excessively accumulate tyrosine and tryptophan, which led to decreased levels of dopamine and 5-hydroxytryptamine and ultimately triggered anxiety-like behaviors. These abnormal changes could be alleviated through intervention with paeonol and the molecular docking suggested paeonol had a good binding with Foxp3. CONCLUSION: Paeonol could alleviate anxiety-like behaviors by enhancing the Treg function through Foxp3 in the spleen, thereby correcting the neurotransmitter metabolic disorders in spleen-brain axis in Pdcd1(-/-).
abstract_zh: 背景：在接受程序性细胞死亡-1（PD-1）阻断治疗的患者中，焦虑症状频繁出现，这与免疫系统的过度激活相关。丹皮酚被描述为能够调节免疫功能并缓解情绪症状，但尚无研究关注其对PD-L1/PD-1阻断治疗所致情绪障碍的作用机制。目的：利用Pdcd1(-/-)小鼠，我们旨在评估丹皮酚的抗焦虑效应，并聚焦于外周免疫器官中T细胞过度激活引起的神经递质代谢转变的机制。方法：在行为学测试的基础上，我们首先量化了Pdcd1(-/-)小鼠两个脑区以及脾脏和淋巴结中关键神经递质及其前体的含量。然后，我们使用流式细胞术结合Treg抑制实验，探讨丹皮酚对CD4(+)T细胞功能的影响。最后，对丹皮酚与叉头框蛋白3（Foxp3）进行分子对接，以预测潜在靶点。结果：在Pdcd1(-/-)小鼠中，Tregs对CD4(+)T细胞的抑制作用减弱，导致脾脏中CD44(high)表达上调。CD4(+)T细胞的这种过度活跃导致脾脏过度积累酪氨酸和色氨酸，进而引起多巴胺和5-羟色胺水平下降，最终触发焦虑样行为。这些异常变化可通过丹皮酚干预得到缓解，分子对接提示丹皮酚与Foxp3具有良好的结合性。结论：丹皮酚可通过增强脾脏中Foxp3介导的Treg功能，纠正Pdcd1(-/-)小鼠脾-脑轴中的神经递质代谢紊乱，从而缓解焦虑样行为。
